title: Cloud Connector locations on the wire: the profile values and what Terraform can manage

prose.text: Cloud Connector deployment locations are read and written through the ZTW `/location` endpoints, whose paths and fields are generated. This subject records the location `profile` values and the Terraform coverage, which an earlier reading got wrong.
The Go SDK's location write sends an empty VPC information object when none is set: [[cloud-connector.sdk-go.service-defects:location-write-emits-empty-vpc-object]].

checks.do: Whether a Cloud Connector location's profile value is one the ZTW contract lists (it includes WORKLOAD), rather than relying on the five-value list in the provider's unregistered resource.

contract-profile-enum.statement: The contract's location create body takes `profile` as one of `NONE`, `CORPORATE`, `SERVER`, `GUESTWIFI`, `IOT` and `WORKLOAD`.

zia-provider-extranet.statement: `EXTRANET`, which the ZIA provider accepts for a ZIA location's profile alongside `WORKLOAD`, is not in that ZTW list.

location-management-data-source-only.statement: The ZTC provider registers `ztc_location_management` as a data source and not as a resource, so Terraform reads Cloud Connector locations but does not create, update or delete them.

quotes: `resource_ztc_location_management.go` is not reconciled because `terraform-provider-ztc` does not register `ztc_location_management` in `ResourcesMap`; it is exposed only as a data source in the captured provider map.

tf-validator-unregistered.statement: The provider's source still has a location management resource file whose `profile` argument accepts `NONE`, `CORPORATE`, `SERVER`, `GUESTWIFI` and `IOT`, described as defaulting to Unassigned when not given.

quotes: "profile": { Type: schema.TypeString, Optional: true, Computed: true, Description: "Profile tag that specifies the location traffic type. If not specified, this tag defaults to `Unassigned`.", ValidateFunc: validation.StringInSlice([]string{ "NONE", "CORPORATE", "SERVER", "GUESTWIFI", "IOT",

validator-applies-to-nothing.statement: Because that resource is not registered, its five-value list constrains no configuration; it is not evidence that a Cloud Connector location cannot carry the `WORKLOAD` profile, which the contract lists.
validator-applies-to-nothing.conditions: Whether the API accepts WORKLOAD on a Cloud Connector location rests on the contract alone; no client or test exercises it.
